primary_documentation.fact: Microsoft lists Apphelp.dll as the DLL supplying SdbGetAppPatchDir, an AppPatch/shim-database-related API. This associates the named Windows component with compatibility infrastructure; it does not authenticate the reported file.

Microsoft describes the application compatibility engine as loader-associated and performing database matching at application start. This makes a startup compatibility association plausible, not a trace of the load in this process.
Microsoft distinguishes compatibility matching, Apphelp messages and Appfix hooks. Mere module presence does not demonstrate that any particular match, message or fix was applied.
A process-specific module snapshot can be requested, errors must be retained, and DATAFILE-style mappings are excluded. A snapshot is not a lifetime/global module history.
GetModuleFileNameW reports a loaded current-process module path, with documented truncation/error and path-format rules. It does not verify file bytes or provenance.
